token_store_classification_label.title: Token Store Data Classification Label
token_store_classification_label.description: The data classification label applied to the session token store (database, cache, file system) as documented in the data inventory or system configuration.

encryption_at_rest_enabled.title: Encryption at Rest Enabled on Token Store
encryption_at_rest_enabled.description: Whether the token store has encryption at rest enabled, consistent with the protection level required for authentication credentials. Covers both primary store and backups; false if either is unencrypted.

access_logging_enabled_on_token_store.title: Access Logging Enabled on Token Store
access_logging_enabled_on_token_store.description: Whether read and write access to the session token store is logged, providing an audit trail consistent with the sensitivity of authentication credentials.

token_retention_policy_days.title: Token Retention Policy (Days)
token_retention_policy_days.description: The number of days session tokens (or their records) are retained in the token store or backups before being purged. -1 indicates no defined retention limit.

token_retention_policy_enforced.title: Token Retention Policy Enforced
token_retention_policy_enforced.description: Whether the system enforces automatic purging or expiration of stored tokens (in databases, caches, audit logs) after their validity window closes.

revoked_token_store_cleanup_enabled.title: Revoked Token Store Cleanup Enabled
revoked_token_store_cleanup_enabled.description: Whether revoked tokens are actively removed from token blacklists or revocation stores after the token's original expiry time has passed.

max_token_retention_days.title: Maximum Token Retention Days Beyond Expiry
max_token_retention_days.description: The maximum number of days session tokens are retained in persistent stores beyond their expiry or revocation. A value greater than 0 indicates tokens survive past their intended validity window.

tokens_logged_in_plaintext.title: Tokens Logged in Plaintext
tokens_logged_in_plaintext.description: Whether raw session token values (signed JWTs, opaque tokens) are written to log files, audit trails, or monitoring systems in cleartext, as detected by log pattern analysis, code review, or SAST tooling.

token_storage_encryption.title: Token Storage Encryption Method
token_storage_encryption.description: The encryption method applied to session tokens at rest in the primary token store (database, cache, session store).

log_token_masking_enabled.title: Token Masking/Redaction Enabled in Logging Pipeline
log_token_masking_enabled.description: Whether the logging configuration or pipeline actively masks, redacts, or suppresses session token values before they are written to log storage or forwarded to aggregators.

log_access_control_scope.title: Log Store Access Control Scope
log_access_control_scope.description: The breadth of principals permitted to read log and audit data containing potential token values, relative to the session store access controls.

token_store_roles_with_read_access.title: Roles/Service Accounts with Token Store Read Access
token_store_roles_with_read_access.description: List of database roles, IAM roles, or service accounts that have SELECT/READ permissions on session token stores (session tables, Redis key namespaces, JWT blacklist stores).

non_auth_roles_require_token_access.title: Non-Auth Roles Require Direct Token Data Access
non_auth_roles_require_token_access.description: True means all roles with token store read access have a documented, function-necessary requirement for direct token data. False means at least one role can read token data without a justified functional need.

token_store_bulk_read_alerting_enabled.title: Bulk Token Read Alerting Enabled
token_store_bulk_read_alerting_enabled.description: True means monitoring/SIEM rules are configured to alert on bulk enumeration or mass extraction of token store records (e.g., full-table scans, KEYS * on Redis, high-volume GET patterns).

secure_deletion_procedure_defined.title: Secure Deletion Procedure Defined and Verified
secure_deletion_procedure_defined.description: Whether a documented and enforced procedure exists for cryptographic erasure or secure deletion of session token data from decommissioned storage volumes, backups, and archival datasets, with evidence of actual execution.

token_revocation_state_persisted_separat.title: Token Revocation State Persisted Separately
token_revocation_state_persisted_separat.description: Whether token revocation state (e.g., a denylist or revocation log) is maintained in a separate, authoritative store that is consulted at validation time, ensuring tokens recovered from improperly disposed media cannot be replayed.
